Garage description
This paint appeared by chance. Mechanics of a workshop before enter to work were sticking gum on the tank in front of the workshop. Over time, the entire hull was covered with a thick layer of chewing gum. And after the tank was brought in and it warmed up, the coating had an interesting visual effect.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint could be received as a reward for completing the challenges of the challenge (05/01/2019 - 05/29/2019) with a battle pass.
